# cratedb_projects (Data Source)

To retrieve all projects.

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    cratedb = {
      source = "thulasirajkomminar/cratedb"
    }
  }
}

data "cratedb_projects" "all" {}

output "project_names" {
  value = [for project in data.cratedb_projects.all.projects : project.name]
}
```
